systems.system: Starlink kits at rural health facilities
systems.owner: Ministry of Health and Child Care
systems.tiers: more than 400 health facilities, described as rural health centres, have received kits, with 300 more to be added; kits not activated for want of subscription payments (July 2026)

note: Connectivity only: the Health Minister told the National Assembly in July 2026 that kits at more than 400 facilities are unactivated because the ministry cannot pay the subscriptions; no HMIS or EMR is named.
